name: Stephan Schaffrath
title: University of Cologne, Germany
bio: For Stephan's PhD he visited the AMNH to receive training in DNA isolation, amplification and sequencing while investigating the chemical composition of scorpion venoms, with a view to using species-specific signatures for systematics. Later, Stephan returned to spend three months at the AMNH generating DNA and morphological data for his PhD thesis, focused on the scorpion genus *Euscorpius* (Euscorpiidae).
